ONE PRODUCT, SIX REAL USES

More than a payment link.

CashDrop turns the shielded pool into a consumer product for gifts, payouts, fundraising, checkout, subscriptions, and onboarding.

01 · CASHDROP

Hand someone digital cash.

Create one private envelope with an optional password and suggested deadline. The recipient claims to any shielded testnet address.

Create one →
02 · DROPBATCH

Pay a room, privately.

Generate independent envelopes for events, community rewards, payroll, or giveaways. Every recipient gets a different seed and address.

03 · PRIVATE FUND

Raise without a donor graph.

Share a campaign page backed by one shielded address. Donor identities, amounts, and public balance are deliberately not published.

04 · RECOVER

The sender stays in control.

Save an offline recovery bundle and sweep an unclaimed envelope back to a shielded wallet. No CashDrop account required.

05 · CHECKOUT

Private point of sale.

Create an exact-price testnet checkout for any product or service. The merchant verifies the shielded payment before fulfilling the order.

06 · PLANS

Subscriptions without wallet authority.

Offer weekly, monthly, or yearly renewal pages. Customers approve each shielded renewal—CashDrop never stores debit permission.

WHY ZCASH

Privacy is the feature—not the decoration.

Zcash’s shielded pool hides sender, recipient, and amount. CashDrop keeps the entire transfer shielded and makes the experience understandable.

CashDrop?

The chain learns less.

  • No public payment graph. A claim does not announce who paid whom.
  • No account database. The app is static and non-custodial.
  • No plaintext secrets on our server. Claim material stays in the URL fragment and is encrypted.
  • Honest limits. The lightwallet gateway can see network metadata; your chat must still be secure.

BUILT FOR THE ZECATHON

Working beats hypothetical.

The browser loads a real WebAssembly Zcash wallet engine, connects to testnet, derives unified addresses, scans compact blocks, constructs proofs locally, and broadcasts shielded transactions.

Before you drop.

Is this real Zcash?

Yes: the live beta uses the public Zcash testnet and produces real testnet shielded addresses and transactions. Testnet coins have no monetary value.

Does the link contain the money?

The link carries encrypted recovery material for a fresh shielded wallet. Treat it like cash: whoever can unlock the complete link may claim first.

Can CashDrop recover my link?

No. CashDrop is non-custodial. Save the recovery file when creating a drop or fund.

Is it mainnet-ready?

Not yet. The current release is explicitly testnet-only and needs an independent security review before handling real value.
